subject.title: [Feature]: Slack Block Kit support for agent messages

question: Should OpenClaw bless a Slack-native Block Kit producer/report surface beyond portable presentation, or keep provider-native blocks as internal/legacy compatibility only?
rationale: Current source supports raw blocks and portable presentation, while repository docs steer new shared sends toward presentation and the remaining request is an API/product boundary rather than a narrow bug fix.

options.title: Keep presentation as the supported API
options.body: Document that new producers should use portable presentation and treat native Slack blocks as existing compatibility/escape-hatch plumbing unless a broader report schema is designed.

options.title: Bless Slack-native producer blocks
options.body: Define and document a trusted Slack-native blocks path with fallback-text requirements, limits, examples, and live Slack proof before implementation.

options.title: Design a broader report schema first
options.body: Pause Slack-specific expansion and open a product/API design for portable report/table/rich_text layouts across channels.

recommendation.title: Keep presentation as the supported API
recommendation.body: Document that new producers should use portable presentation and treat native Slack blocks as existing compatibility/escape-hatch plumbing unless a broader report schema is designed.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned on the live issue and have the strongest merged-history connection to the Slack Block Kit slices already landed.
